title: pb_decode
description: `pb_decode` decodes length-prefixed Protocol Buffers frames, such as byte lists from `comport`, and outputs one `field <tag> <wire_type> <value>` message per field plus an `ok <nfields>` or `error <reason>` status. By default, 64-bit varint and fixed64 values are emitted as symbols; use `-float` for potentially lossy floats or `-split` for high/low 32-bit floats.
